details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: symlink attacks on daemon operator-supplied paths
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53784.patch: add
       safe_open_no_attacker_symlinks() in util.c and confine the daemon
       module-root chdir under use-chroot=no
     - CVE-2026-53784
   * SECURITY UPDATE: information disclosure via planted symlinks
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53802-CVE-2026-53803.patch: open the secrets
       file, --password-file, batch, log, config and exclude/include files
       through safe_open_no_attacker_symlinks()
     - CVE-2026-53802
     - CVE-2026-53803
   * SECURITY UPDATE: information disclosure via symlinked filter/merge files
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53786.patch: open filter and per-directory merge
       files through safe_open_no_attacker_symlinks() and treat a merge file
       hidden by the daemon filter as absent
     - CVE-2026-53786
   * SECURITY UPDATE: arbitrary file write via absolute --temp-dir/--link-dest
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53795.patch: confine do_rename() and do_link()
       in syscall.c through an ownership walk on the pinned parent directory fd
     - CVE-2026-53795
   * SECURITY UPDATE: daemon crash via a malformed file list entry
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70459.patch: reject a non-directory
       transfer-root entry and bound parent_ndx in flist.c, generator.c and
       receiver.c
     - CVE-2026-70459
   * SECURITY UPDATE: "auth users" entries parsed on whitespace
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70463.patch: parse the daemon's "auth users"
       list with conf_strtok() in authenticate.c so it splits on commas alone
     - CVE-2026-70463
   * The non-directory transfer-root guard shipped in +tuxcare.els5 under
     debian/patches/CVE-2026-53789.patch now lives in
     debian/patches/CVE-2026-70459.patch, no functional change
   * The upstream regression tests named in the patch headers are not carried:
     upstream ships them only as pytest testsuite/*_test.py files and 3.1.3
     has no pytest harness
